 Published Oct. 28, 2026 11:21 p.m. ET share facebook x reddit link Associated Press AUSTIN, Texas (AP) — Saba Lobjanidze and Morgan Guilavogui scored six minutes apart as Real Salt Lake beat Austin 2-1 on Wednesday night.
 Salt Lake (12-14-6), which entered two points shy of the ninth place LA Galaxy, extended its unbeaten streak to four games. 
 Austin (8-14-10) was eliminated from playoff contention. 
 Jorge Alastuey opened the scoring for Austin in the 52nd minute with a shot from distance past a diving Rafael Cabral .
 Three minutes later, Lobjanidze tied it on a bending shot into the corner of the goal to tie it at 1-all. 
 Guilavogui scored the go-ahead goal in the 61st after a nice individual effort by Sergi Solans left him wide open on a breakaway for a well-timed pass. 
 Up next
 Salt Lake: Plays at San Jose on Saturday.
 Austin: Plays at the LA Galaxy on Saturday.
